decisions.reason: As a newly introduced flagship security feature in the firm's core digital identity portfolio, it is more likely to be developed further than withdrawn in 2024.
Although digital payment wallets face strong competition and regulatory complexity, this product fits the firm's secure identity and payment focus, so management would likely continue it for now.
The NFC login authenticator is somewhat niche and hardware-dependent, which raises discontinuation risk, but it still complements the firm's authentication and security offering.
A secure payment and wallet framework appears strategically central and was important enough to receive its own page, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.

A secure platform for building multi-service mobile apps supports enterprise customers and broader solution sales, so an established German software-security firm would typically keep investing in it.
Application shielding is a core security capability and this product had dedicated website visibility, so management would be unlikely to remove it so soon after launch.
